subject.title: [Feature]: `announceTarget` option for sub-agent completion announce routing

question: Should OpenClaw accept `announceTarget: "channel" | "parent"` as a public native `sessions_spawn` and `agents.*.subagents` contract?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix adds durable model-facing and config semantics in a compatibility-sensitive agent delivery path, which requires maintainer product intent.

options.title: Accept narrow opt-in parent routing
options.body: Review and land the linked PR or equivalent after default channel behavior remains unchanged and real behavior proof covers parent wake/no direct channel announce.

options.title: Per-spawn only first
options.body: Accept only the model-facing per-call option and defer global/per-agent defaults until operator and upgrade semantics are reviewed separately.

options.title: Keep workaround-only behavior
options.body: Reject or pause the native contract and leave parent handoff to explicit `sessions_send` patterns until a broader orchestration design is chosen.

recommendation.title: Accept narrow opt-in parent routing
recommendation.body: Review and land the linked PR or equivalent after default channel behavior remains unchanged and real behavior proof covers parent wake/no direct channel announce.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the tool, owns much of the spawn/announce history, and already described the focused implementation shape on this issue.
